The Sr Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that a product or feature is developed with a focus on delivering value to the customer and the business. They act as a voice for the customer and are responsible for making key product-related decisions throughout the development process, including identifying opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled capabilities, where they can improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.

Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment
Translation: Work with stakeholders to translate future vision and requirements into clearly broken-down epics and stories; ensure all team members understand and align with product goals, including consideration of emerging technologies where appropriate.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact between the development team and stakeholders; communicate progress, changes, and updates regularly.
Team Enabler: Work with one or more Agile Development Teams and act as a central reference and information source, guiding system/product functionality decisions.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrate a track record of delivering results in fast-moving, demanding environments.
Backlog Ownership & Prioritization
Prioritization: Create and maintain the product backlog; prioritize features, user stories, and tasks based on business value, customer needs, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
Backlog Management: Continuously groom and refine the backlog based on feedback, changing priorities, and new insights.
Feedback Integration: Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and end-users into the backlog; adjust as necessary.

User Story Development: Break down high-level requirements into detailed, implementable user stories that meet strong Agile standards and support effective workflows, automation, and decision support where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Define clear acceptance criteria so the team understands what constitutes “done” for each feature.
UI/UX Alignment: Partner with UX to ensure backlog items have wireframes and UI designs ready for sprint planning; provide design feedback, participate in design sprints, and support user acceptance testing.
Planning, Delivery & Risk
Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning to select stories and tasks; ensure the team has a clear understanding of work scope.
Release Planning: Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to plan and prioritize releases aligned with market needs and business goals.
Quality Assurance: Ensure the product meets quality standards by accepting or rejecting work during sprint reviews.
Risk Management: Identify and mitigate delivery risks; partner with the release manager on timelines, tough conversations, mitigation strategies, and transparent escalation to leadership.
Business Outcomes & Data
Business Case Support: Assist in developing and presenting business cases for new features and initiatives; ensure alignment with strategic goals and stakeholder expectations.
Data-Driven: Define KPIs and measures for features and capabilities to track impact and inform decisions.

Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
4-7 years of relevant work experience
Experience with Product and Development tools such as ADO, Jira or other similar tools.
Healthcare and technical expertise are highly preferred, including experience with data, API integrations, and interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and assess opportunities related to emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, where applicable.

Excellent communication and presentation abilities

Provation’s comprehensive portfolio spans the entire patient encounter, from pre-procedure through post-procedure, with solutions for physician and nursing documentation (Provation® MD, Provation® Apex, MD-Reports, Provation® endoPRO®, and Provation® MultiCaregiver), anesthesia documentation (#1 Best in KLAS Provation® iPro), patient engagement, surgical care coordination, quality reporting, and billing capture (Provation® SurgicalValet™), order set and care plan management (Provation® Order Set Advisor™ and Provation® Care Plans), and EHR embedded clinical documentation (Provation® Clinic Note).

Provation has a loyal customer base, serving more than 5,000 hospitals, surgery centers, and medical offices, and 700 physician groups globally, including 19 of the top 20 U.S. hospitals.

In 2021, Provation was acquired by Fortive Corporation, a Fortune 1000 company that builds essential technology and accelerates transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, engineering, and healthcare. The eRA Product Manager within Notre Dame Research serves as the strategic owner of the University’s electronic Research Administration (eRA) ecosystem. This position is responsible for the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the administrative systems that support the University’s research enterprise.

The eRA Product Manager partners closely with Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and external software vendors to ensure research administration and compliance platforms align with institutional priorities, federal compliance requirements, and the evolving needs of faculty and research staff.

In this role, the eRA Product Manager acts as a high-level consultant to University leadership, translating strategic research objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, compliance readiness, and proposal competitiveness.

Most immediately, the successful candidate in collaboration with the Associate Vice President of Research and the Director of Research Effectiveness and Analytics will play a defining leadership role in steering the University through a major eRA implementation, shaping the future of Notre Dame’s research infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities Define, manage, and execute the product roadmap for the University’s electronic Research Administration systems, prioritizing enhancements and feature releases that streamline workflows and reduce administrative burden.

Serve as the primary liaison between Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and third-party software vendors to advocate for institutional needs and influence product development.

Lead system governance and integration strategy for research administration platforms, ensuring effective data exchange between eRA systems, HRIS, ERP, and other enterprise applications. Oversee research data governance practices to establish consistent standards, improve data quality, and support reliable institutional reporting and analytics.

Configure and maintain system validations and workflows to support evolving federal regulations and sponsor requirements, including NSF, NIH, USDA, and other compliance standards. Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and enhanced reporting capabilities.

Develop and maintain system documentation, business processes, and training materials to support successful adoption of system enhancements and transitions. Lead “train-the-trainer” initiatives and support change management efforts across the research community.

Monitor system performance, user feedback, and emerging industry trends to inform continuous improvement efforts. Support reporting and data visualization activities to translate research administration data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making.

Support audit readiness activities by ensuring accurate system configurations, data integrity, and compliance documentation. Participate in vendor user groups, professional organizations, and research administration communities to stay informed on best practices and emerging technologies.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Research Administration, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in research administration, enterprise systems management, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in a leadership, Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar strategic systems role.

Experience supporting enterprise-level software implementations, preferably within research administration, ERP, or higher education environments. Expert understanding of the research grant lifecycle, including pre-award, post-award, and compliance functions.

Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, integrations, and data governance principles. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct supervisory authority. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify operational trends.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including faculty and senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a dynamic environment. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and compliance requirements.

Preferred qualifications Experience working within higher education research administration environments. Familiarity with eRA systems, ERP platforms, and SaaS-to-on-premises data integrations. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Knowledge of federal research compliance regulations and sponsored program administration. Please include a cover letter and resume to be considered for this role. Salary up to $113,500, commensurate with experience. Applications due by July 27 2026.

Comfort with technical concepts — data, APIs, and AI/LLM-driven workflows — and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and data science. Sound prioritization and judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, drawing on both qualitative and quantitative evidence.

Strong communication and collaboration skills across internal product, design, engineering, and commercial teams as well as external integration partners. Experience contributing to a product or product line that scaled to $50M+ in revenue, from build through launch. Preferred Qualifications An advanced degree (PhD or MS) in a life-sciences field.

The Problem Worth Solving
Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses.
The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth.
CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents.

What You'll Be Building

As Technical Product Manager – AI & Agents, you'll own the product definition and roadmap for integrating CAST 's platforms — CAST Imaging and CAST Highlight — into the agentic AI ecosystem. Concretely:
MCP Server & Agentic integrations. CAST Imaging already exposes its structural insights via an MCP server, making any MCP-aware agent — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini — structurally aware of the application it's working on. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams.
Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering.
GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports.
Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. You'll translate emerging research into product bets, defining what gets productized and when.

Hands-on background in software engineering or architecture. You can read a call graph, understand what a dependency means in practice, and have opinions about technical debt.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM integrations, or developer tooling — building products or shipping integrations.
Ability to work across research, engineering, and commercial teams — and translate between all three.
Fluent English. Our teams and partners are global.

Why This Role The intersection of software intelligence and AI agents is where the next generation of enterprise software transformation will be decided. You'll work with a research team that publishes with Google Cloud, ships MCP integrations used by real enterprise customers, and is actively pushing the frontier on how AI understands software at scale. The scope is real. The partners are serious. The problem is unsolved. Reporting to : Head of R&D Originally posted on Himalayas

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries.
The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide.

In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout.

We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.
As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences.
Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.
Our humble expectations
You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:
Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager
It’s a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.
Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!
Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung
Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub (bei Vollzeit), Homeoffice-Anteil, unbefristete Festanstellung
Attraktives Einkommen sowie Benefits wie Team- und Firmenevents, Firmen-Fitnessangebot und Dienstrad-Leasing

At Groups, our mission is to deliver life-changing care to individuals struggling with substance use disorders. We are building technology-enabled care models that improve access, outcomes, and experience for our members, at scale.
We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead strategy and execution across a critical portfolio of products and platforms at the core of our clinical and operational ecosystem. This is a highly influential, senior individual contributor role with broad ownership, significant autonomy, and direct impact on how care is delivered.
The Opportunity
This is a high-impact role. You will operate at the intersection of clinical care, technology, and growth, owning a portfolio that directly shapes member engagement, clinical outcomes, and operational efficiency.
You will set direction, define success, and drive enterprise-level decisions, while raising the bar for product management across the organization.
This position is fully remote, however, for this role, we are prioritizing candidates who align with the Eastern time zone (EDT/EST) for consistent overlap and availability with our core clinical and operational teams.

What You’ll Own
Define and lead the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of interconnected products and platforms.
Own end-to-end outcomes, including performance, adoption, and impact across systems and vendor partnerships.
Establish and drive a metrics framework that sets the standard for product performance and accountability.
Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions, balancing speed, cost, and long-term scalability.
Partner with Engineering on architecture and platform decisions, ensuring alignment with business and clinical priorities.
Design member-centric experiences, including conversational and interaction flows that guide individuals to the right care at the right time.
Influence cross-functional strategy and investment decisions across Product, Clinical Operations, Growth, IT, and external partners.
Shape how adjacent teams prioritize and execute work beyond your direct scope.
Establish governance, documentation, and compliance standards to support scale in a regulated healthcare environment.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Improve member engagement and care navigation through thoughtful product design.
Drive measurable gains in clinical outcomes and operational efficiency.
Elevate product practice through data rigor, experimentation, and mentorship.
Enable smarter, faster decisions through clear metrics and actionable insights.

7–10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platforms, infrastructure, or shared systems at scale.
Experience operating at a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior IC level.
Proven ability to define and execute portfolio-level strategy across complex, interconnected systems.
Strong track record of data-driven decision-making, including defining and operationalizing metrics.
Experience designing conversational or AI-driven user experiences (chat, voice, messaging).
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations.
Technical fluency to partner effectively on architecture, integration, and reliability trade-offs.
Demonstrated ability to raise the bar for product teams through mentorship, standards, and best practices.

Healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated, mission-critical environments.
Experience with automation, messaging platforms, or AI-enabled product strategies.
History of insourcing vendor capabilities or rebuilding critical systems.
Contributions to scaling product organizations (hiring, leveling, coaching).
Please note: This role is not available to residents of AK, AR, CA, HI, ID, MD, NE, SD, UT, or WY.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
As a Product Manager for our eCommerce Solutions team , you will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine (our core white-label product) that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets.

Timely and High-Quality Delivery of Roadmap : Ensure the successful and timely delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This includes:
Achieve on-time delivery of planned iterations and releases, meeting or exceeding project milestones.
Maintain a backlog of well-defined and prioritized user stories that align with customer needs and business goals.
Minimize scope changes and rework through effective communication and requirement validation.
Stakeholder Alignment : Establish strong communication channels with stakeholders and ensure a shared understanding of product vision, progress, and timelines. This includes:
Build and maintain trust-based relationships with stakeholders by providing clear, structured, and consistent communication.
Proactively address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations to ensure alignment with the product roadmap.
Data-informed decisions : Drive continuous improvement of the product through data analysis, user feedback, and iterative development cycles. This includes:
Monitor and analyze key product and team KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, user engagement) to identify opportunities for enhancement.
Utilize data insights to prioritize features and improvements that have the highest impact on user satisfaction and business goals.
Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.

At least 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Owner
Have user-centric thinking: Ability to empathize with users, understand their needs, and prioritize features based on their value and impact
Strong communicator: You possess verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the product vision, requirements, and updates to both the development team and stakeholders
Know Agile Methodology: You are proficient in Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum) to manage iterative development, prioritize work, and respond to changing requirements.
Hands-on with user story writing: You are able to break down complex features into clear and concise user stories that capture user needs, acceptance criteria, and business value.
Technically savvy: You understand the technical aspects of the product domain, allowing effective translation of requirements into actionable tasks for the development team.
Data-driven decision mindset: Your skills in using data and analytics help you make informed decisions, monitor KPIs, and identify areas for product improvement.
Problem-Solving approach: You are able to identify and address challenges that arise during product development, find creative solutions, and make timely adjustments.
Adaptability: You are willing to embrace change and adapt to evolving user needs, market trends, and business priorities
Experience with B2C products is a plus.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company

We are building a SaaS platform that packages Autodesk Consulting’s intellectual property — proven workflows, implementation guidance, learning content, and tooling recommendations — into a scalable digital experience that connects customers and internal Autodesk consultants to the knowledge they need to drive successful digital transformation. The platform is new, the roadmap is ambitious, and the details matter enormously.
As Platform Product Owner, you sit at the critical intersection of product vision and engineering execution. You work closely with the Platform Product Manager to deeply understand strategic intent, and you are responsible for translating that intent into well-defined, sprint-ready user stories that development teams can build with confidence.

You collaborate closely with our UI/UX designer to ensure high-fidelity wireframes and prototypes reflect both the product vision and the detailed requirements that make them buildable.

You work directly with scrum teams across India and Poland to clarify requirements at the detail level, resolve ambiguity, and maintain alignment between what gets built and what was intended.
This role requires someone who is energized by the craft of breaking complex problems into clear, executable work — and who understands that maintaining the integrity of the product vision through the details of execution is one of the most important and underappreciated skills in product development.

Break down high-level epics and product requirements into clearly defined, sprint-ready user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria
Develop a deep understanding of the platform product vision and serve as its guardian at the execution layer, ensuring that detail-level decisions remain true to strategic intent
Work closely with the Platform Product Manager to clarify priorities and translate roadmap direction into actionable work for scrum teams
Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to ensure wireframes and prototypes accurately reflect detailed requirements before development begins
Partner with globally distributed scrum teams in India and Poland to answer questions, resolve ambiguity, and maintain development momentum
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks in requirements early, and escalate or resolve them before they impact delivery
Maintain and manage the product backlog, ensuring it is well-organized, up to date, and accurately reflects current priorities
Adapt to shifting team assignments and priorities as the product and operating model evolve

4+ years of experience in a product ownership or equivalent role
Demonstrated ability to break down complex, ambiguous product requirements into well-defined, executable user stories
Strong capacity to internalize and represent a product vision, maintaining its integrity through detailed execution without requiring constant direction
Experience working directly with engineering teams, including clarifying requirements and supporting development through delivery
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, early-stage product environment where priorities shift and the operating model continues to evolve
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams and time zones
Experience collaborating with UI/UX designers to align detailed requirements with high-fidelity design artifacts
Experience With Technologies Such As
Jira for backlog management and sprint planning

The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate understands that product vision is only as strong as the execution that delivers it. They take ownership of the space between strategic direction and engineering delivery — not waiting to be told what every story should say, but actively working to understand the intent behind the roadmap and making thoughtful, independent decisions about how to express that intent in the details.
They are exceptionally good at their craft. Writing clear, well-structured user stories with meaningful acceptance criteria is not a chore for them — it is how they think. They anticipate the questions engineers will ask before they are asked, and they close gaps before they become problems.
They are a disciplined collaborator. They work closely with the Platform PM without needing everything spelled out, and they work closely with designers and engineering teams without losing the thread of what the product is trying to accomplish. They understand that in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, a strong Product Owner is what stands between a well-articulated vision and a product that drifts from it in the details.

YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data.
As a Data Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in making that vision a reality. You will own the path from raw alternative data to trusted, product ready intelligence—determining how complex datasets are structured, interpreted, and ultimately surfaced to customers.
This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist.
Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time.

Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design
Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products.
Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted.
Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation.
Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs.
AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems
Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails.
Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers.
Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible.
Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior.
Product Development & Customer Problem Solving
Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities.
Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product.
Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence
Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production.
Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions.
Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences.
Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases.
You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have
3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field.
Strong fluency in SQL; comfort with data pipelines, schema changes, and upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Experience owning data documentation, metric definitions, or data quality programs—not just conducting ad hoc analysis.
A track record of cross-functional coordination, ideally between technical data teams and product or commercial stakeholders.
Strong project management instincts: you can run a triage process, maintain a quality library, and coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups without dropping balls.
Clear, structured communication—you can translate complex data methodology questions into guidance that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
A demonstrable track record of building—shipping things, solving hard problems, and leaving a clear mark on the products you’ve worked on.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, energized by new problem spaces, and don’t need a fully paved road to make progress.
Deep experience with alternative data, panel data, or similarly complex, nuanced data sources is required—you need to understand the quirks, limitations, and methodological subtleties of these datasets and be able to encode that understanding for an AI driven product.
Prior experience in or exposure to AI/ML products, LLM-based agents, or evaluation frameworks is a strong plus.

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The Opportunity
9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com .

But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy.

You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors.

You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data.

The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch
Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.
The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.
What you'll work on
Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain
Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.
Our humble expectations
We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.
You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.
Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies.

Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.
This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.
This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.

Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.
Talk to users directly . Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.
Do your own data work . You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.
Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan . Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.
Design and run tests . Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.
Drive product development from concept to launch . Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making
Own the outcome, not the output . Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.
Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about.

6+ years in product, with meaningful time on products where the software coordinates real-world processes - staffing, logistics, fintech ops, healthcare, or similar, with substantial business impact. You have experience in marketplace dynamics and allocation problems.
You've shipped something complex end-to-end and can talk credibly about what broke, not just what launched.
You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists.
You've moved teams you don't manage . Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job.

AI is already part of how you work , and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers

About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own
Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.
Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.
Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.
Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.
Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.
Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.
Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.
Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.
Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.
Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.
Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Engineering or highly technical product background.
Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Outcome
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
Location
This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people.

About the Opportunity
In this role, you will join MoonPay’s Crypto Asset Management team as a Product Manager, helping us build and scale the liquidity and asset infrastructure that supports products across MoonPay.
The team is responsible for how liquidity is sourced and distributed across our platform, supporting high-value crypto transaction volumes across multiple assets, venues, and blockchains. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it.
You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

CAS Shield & Apply
📍 Location: Remote (with purpose-driven in-person meetups in London)

📅 Start Date: Immediate
💼 Reporting to: Deputy Director of CAS Shield, with a dotted line to the Deputy Director of Apply
🛂 Note: Candidates must be UK-based, have the right to work in the UK, and be able to travel to London for team meet-ups
About Enroly
At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

s.h: This role sits across our two core products
s.t:
CAS Shield — our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.
Apply — our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.
Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.
This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.
Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.
Your job is to make that experience work — fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.
This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.
Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.
Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.
Lead the mobile-first applicant experience — video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.
Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps — transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection — while keeping humans accountable for decisions.
Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.
Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants and internal stakeholders to understand how interviews are created, completed, reviewed and used in admissions and compliance decisions.
Lead product discovery —Conduct discovery across the full interview lifecycle, including interview creation, applicant completion, assessment, reviewer workflows and institutional decision-making.
Work day-to-day with a dedicated squad: writing and refining user stories, managing backlogs, setting acceptance criteria, and collaborating closely with developers and QA.
Prioritise and execute improvements, from bug triage and fixes to new feature delivery, based on business impact and user feedback.
Post-launch analysis: track usage, completion and assessment quality, gather feedback, and use data to continuously iterate.
Champion compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g. UKVI credibility expectations, data protection, auditability) in product decisions and design.
Be the internal advocate for interviewing at Enroly, aligning teams around shared goals and user outcomes.
What Success Looks Like
High applicant completion rates and a demonstrably better interview experience, particularly on mobile.
Institutions trust the assessment output enough to make decisions on it — and can defend those decisions.
Interview integrity is measurably strong, with fraud and impersonation risk reduced without punishing genuine applicants.
Meaningful reduction in manual reviewer effort per interview.
Interviewing works as one coherent capability across CAS Shield and Apply.
Efficient prioritisation and execution of improvements and fixes.
Alignment with wider business and regulatory goals.
Who You’ll Work With
Product team: PMs, Designers, Solutions, Integrations
Tech team: Developers, QA — including mobile and AI/ML capability
Wider Enroly teams: Customer Success Managers, Compliance, Services, Marketing
Clients: university admissions and compliance teams, agent partners, and applicants
Challenges You’ll Tackle
Building a high-stakes, high-scrutiny product area where getting it wrong has real consequences for applicants and institutions.
Balancing integrity and assurance against applicant experience and completion.
Delivering a reliable video and mobile experience across highly variable devices, networks and geographies.
Serving two products with different lifecycles, users and delivery rhythms.
Working in an environment with limited resources and many competing voices.
Balancing short-term fixes with strategic improvements.
Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes in the education sector.
A growing team, evolving processes, and a high bar for quality.

Essential
3–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS product management.
Hands-on product experience in at least one of: asynchronous or video interviewing, remote proctoring or online assessment, identity verification, or another integrity-critical product area.
Experience delivering mobile or mobile-web products, with a real understanding of the constraints — device fragmentation, media capture, bandwidth, permissions, accessibility.
Strong execution skills: product discovery, prioritisation, delivery.
Fluency with qualitative and quantitative data.
Confident in internal and external stakeholder management, with strong communication and presentation skills.

We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands.
A Staff Product Manager operates and drives vision across product areas. You own a problem space that spans multiple surfaces, or one so foundational that getting it right shapes how everything else at ClickUp works. You still build.

The strategy is sharper because you are prototyping the cross-cutting workflow yourself, reading data wherever it shows up, and sitting on customer calls that span the whole problem. You scale impact by inventing leverage that other PMs adopt, wiring up AI workflows that keep you current on more signals than any one person could manually track.

The scope is wide on purpose, and you find new ways to cover it.

Define and own a cross-functional problem space or a foundational platform area whose quality shapes outcomes across multiple product surfaces.
Drive strategic alignment across product areas. Identify the decisions that unblock the most work and make them.
Synthesize signals from customer calls, data, support trends, and partner feedback across your entire scope, not just your immediate surface.
Prototype cross-cutting workflows and concepts yourself. The strategy is more credible when you have already tested it.
Identify leverage and share it. Build AI workflows, frameworks, and patterns that other PMs on the team can adopt.
Mentor and stretch Senior PMs. Raise the floor of the function, not just your own output.
Represent the product voice in senior leadership conversations and contribute to decisions that span multiple teams.
Contribute to how the PM function operates, including how we run discovery, define quality, and measure success.

Track record of mentoring and elevating other PMs, not just shipping your own work.
Strong data instincts. You can pull your own analysis, define the right metrics, and spot when a number is telling the wrong story.
Experienced with AI tooling and actively finding new ways to scale your own coverage through it.

The Profiles Platform team owns Klaviyo’s core customer data system, the foundation that powers every product experience across the platform. This team is responsible for storing, managing, and serving customer profile data as the source of truth for downstream products like segmentation, flows, reporting, and analytics.

Their work ensures that profile data is accurate, scalable, and usable across the entire product ecosystem. From improving data modeling and computed properties to enabling enterprise-scale ingestion and supporting global compliance needs, this team plays a critical role in making Klaviyo’s platform intelligent and reliable at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s Profiles Platform. In this role, you will define how customer profile data is structured, processed, and served across the platform.

You’ll work at the intersection of data infrastructure, computed data, and scalability, ensuring that profile data remains trustworthy and performant as Klaviyo grows into more complex enterprise and global use cases. This is a high-impact platform role where your work will directly influence nearly every product team and customer experience.

Please note that this is an onsite role that requires 5 days/week in our Boston office. Fully remote candidates will not be considered at this time.
How You’ll Make a Difference
Own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s core profile data system, including profile traits, transformations, and storage layers
Serve as the product owner for the source of truth for customer data across the platform
Partner closely with engineering to evolve profile data architecture and services at massive scale
Collaborate with the Identity, Data, and Consent teams to ensure accurate and unified customer records
Drive improvements in profile data quality, usability, and modeling for downstream consumers (segmentation, flows, analytics, AI)
Enable enterprise and global expansion by supporting data residency, compliance, and regional infrastructure requirements
Define and track key metrics around data quality, performance, and system efficiency
What You’ll Work On
Building a computed properties platform to support derived traits (e.g., LTV, recency/frequency, propensity scoring)
Improving profile data modeling and transformations to make data more usable across the platform
Scaling ingestion systems to support billions of profiles and high-throughput workloads
Reducing cost and improving performance through sharding, traffic smoothing, and optimized write patterns
Supporting identity quality initiatives (e.g., deduplication, multi-email profiles, probabilistic matching)
Enabling regulated and global use cases, including data residency (e.g., EU, Japan) and compliance requirements

About Chili Piper
Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.
We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Orchestrator, Chili Piper's GTM Control Layer.
Internally, we think of this role as a Product Market Fitter. This is not a traditional roadmap management role. It is a product leadership role for someone who loves building complex, enterprise-grade products and has the judgment to turn customer and market evidence into focused product bets that drive real adoption and business impact.
Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. That includes catching a form abandonment, a no-show, a missed meeting, or a cold chat, checking ICP fit, account ownership, intent history, and CRM state, then firing the right next step: enrolling a sequence in Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong Engage, notifying a rep, rescheduling a meeting, or sending a booking link.
You will own the full arc of a product bet: target customer, first audience, market and customer evidence, problem definition, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, success metrics, first adoption trigger, usage learning, and business outcome.
You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.
This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

Own Orchestrator end to end, from market and customer evidence through adoption, iteration, and long-term business impact
Define the first audience for every bet and protect that focus as new requests, edge cases, and opportunities emerge
Identify the right problems to solve and turn signal detection, decisioning, and action-taking into clear product direction
Define value, viability, priority, and success metrics, including what should trigger first adoption
Monitor adoption and real usage after launch, then use what you learn to improve the product and shape what comes next
Keep signal types, decision logic, and external integrations coherent, so the system stays predictable and trustworthy as it grows
Partner with Product Design on the experience, first-use path, and product-side enablement
Partner with the Product Engineering Lead on solutions that are technically sound and practical to deliver
Prioritize ruthlessly and make clear calls when the problem is complex and the answer is not obvious
Hold a high standard for quality. You do not ship things you would not want to use yourself

Senior-level experience managing complex B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of a product area or major initiatives
Strong product judgment, with the ability to find problems worth solving and make informed tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
Hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product work, with good judgment about where AI genuinely improves a product experience
The ability to simplify complexity and turn customer evidence, data, and technical constraints into clear product decisions
Deep curiosity about users and markets, and a habit of building conviction through direct evidence
Comfort in technical domains and credibility with technical users and engineering partners
A bias toward focus and shipping narrow to learn quickly
