s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.
As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value.

Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.
If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.
Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.
Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.
Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.
Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.
What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.
Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.
Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.
Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.
High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.
Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.
Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.
Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. You’ll be a critical member of the Engage group, responsible for building long-term product value and loyalty across our Kraken products—on both mobile and web.

Partner with Marketing and Lifecycle teams to build targeted engagement campaigns and personalized messaging strategies (e.g., push, in-app, email) based on behavioral insights
Design and refine client segmentation frameworks to personalize the experience and optimize journeys
Collaborate closely with Business Leads for Consumer and Pro segments to align product goals with user personas, market demands, and business objectives

About Hightouch
Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.
Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.
Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.
At Hightouch , our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.
About the Product Team
You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing.
Why this role matters
This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch 's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core.
What you’ll own
We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch : the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning:
Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch
Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance
Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments
Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns
Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch
We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio.

The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include:
Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs
Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions
Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing
This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy.

Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them.
Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently.
Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action.
Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception.
Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results.

At AlertMedia , we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.
Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:
We’re humans not robots
Customers always come first
We work better together
Simplicity is our strength
Our reputation is priceless
Hard work pays off
As one of the fastest growing software companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand. We’re also an AI-forward company, and we expect everyone on our team to use modern AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and optimize processes.
We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn real-world security expertise into Social Intelligence software that helps teams identify credible threats sooner and protect people when it matters most.

You have spent time in the seat we build for. You have monitored a developing situation with incomplete information, decided whether a signal was credible enough to escalate, and lived with the consequences of that call. You know the difference between noise and a genuine indicator, and you know how much of that work is still done by hand.
Now you want to solve those problems at scale for thousands of security teams instead of one. You are curious about how customers actually work rather than how they say they work, comfortable making decisions with imperfect data, and energized by turning a messy operational problem into software that ships. You are as interested in the practitioner’s daily reality as you are in the roadmap that serves it.
Risk Intelligence is one of the fastest-moving areas of our product. Open sources surface indicators of violence, unrest, executive targeting, brand-directed activity, and physical risk earlier than any other channel — and separating the meaningful few from the overwhelming many is the hard problem. You will own how AlertMedia solves it.

s.h: What you get to do every day
s.t:
Customer and Market Understanding
Develop deep expertise in the personas we serve — corporate security, intelligence analysts, executive protection, threat assessment, brand and communications teams — including how their work is structured, staffed, measured, and escalated.
Interview customers and prospects continuously. Run discovery conversations, ride-alongs, and feedback sessions that produce specific problem statements rather than feature requests.
Maintain a clear, current view of the problems we solve well today, where we can improve, and the problems we should be solving 12 to 24 months from now.
Track industry trends, threat landscape shifts, platform and data-access changes, regulatory developments, and the competitive field, and translate them into implications for our roadmap.
Prioritization and Roadmap Ownership
Own a value stream in the Risk Intelligence roadmap: decide what we build, what we defer, and what we decline, with reasoning that stands up to scrutiny.
Balance business objectives, customer needs, and industry trends when sequencing work, and make the tradeoffs explicit to stakeholders.
Define the problem sets and jobs to be done that anchor each initiative, so the team understands the outcome before it debates the solution.
Working With Development and Design
Partner with Engineering and Design to translate customer problems into specifications, acceptance criteria, and deliverable milestones the team can execute against.
Break large initiatives into releasable increments that produce customer value early and inform what comes next.
Stay close through delivery — grooming, scope decisions, testing, and launch readiness — and resolve ambiguity before it becomes rework.
Prototyping With AI Tooling
Use AI development and design tools such as Claude Code, Claude Design, and Codex to build working prototypes, pressure-test concepts, and put something tangible in front of customers in days rather than quarters.
Treat prototypes as a research method: use them to invalidate weak ideas inexpensively and to sharpen strong ones before Engineering commits.
Bring that fluency to the wider product team and raise the bar for how quickly we can move from idea to evidence.
Measurement
Define what success looks like before launch — adoption, analyst efficiency, signal quality, retention impact, revenue contribution — and instrument for it.
Analyze product usage data and customer outcomes after release, report honestly on what worked and what did not, and feed those findings into the next round of prioritization.
Go-To-Market Enablement
Work with Product Marketing to position new capabilities, shape messaging, and equip Sales, Customer Success, and Support to sell and support them with confidence.
Translate product functionality into narratives and practical applications that customer-facing teams can use in real conversations.
Lead internal training, demos, and Q&A sessions so the organization understands not just what shipped but why it matters to the people who use it.

Resourcefulness — you keep going when the path is not clear.

Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization & automation platform, helping companies eliminate manual tasks and control purchasing activities across all subsidiaries. s.t:

We're looking for a proactive, hands-on Payments Product Manager with a track record of owning payment integrations end-to-end.
You'll take full ownership of how Precoro connects to payment providers and processes transactions, making sure the payment layer scales reliably across our customers in 80+ countries.
This role comes with real autonomy: room to bring your own ideas, drive the direction, and the resources to make it happen - without micromanagement or endless approval chains.

Own the Payments product area end-to-end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration
Understand customer payment workflows across our global client base and translate them into a prioritized, ROI-driven roadmap
Create and maintain integrations with payment providers, ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across markets
Coordinate across Engineering, CS, Marketing, Sales, and external payment partners to keep the product ready for new markets and payment methods
Define and track success metrics, using data to identify friction points and measure impact on adoption and revenue
Lead your cross-functional team, setting a standard for clear documentation, sharp prioritization, and shipping with quality
What we look for
Hands-on experience building or scaling payment integrations from scratch (routing, PSP/acquirer integrations, virtual cards, ACH, or cross-border payments)
3-5+ years as a Product Manager, with a track record of shipping features end-to-end
Strong ability to work with APIs and technical integrations, including the messy parts: partner limitations, versioning, error handling, reconciliation
Critical thinking and comfort navigating ambiguous, multi-layered problems with no obvious shortcuts
Outstanding skills in stakeholder management - you can align internal teams, and external partners around a shared roadmap
Experience working with data to inform decisions - comfortable writing SQL queries or using BI tools (Power BI/Tableau/Looker) for KPI analysis
Nice-to-have skills
Experience with B2B SaaS or API-first product development
Familiarity with using AI tools as part of your day-to-day product workflow

RIBAG ist die führende Schweizer Lichtmarke für Räume mit hoher Aufenthaltsqualität. Wir gestalten Licht für anspruchsvolle Architektur, schaffen Atmosphäre und verleihen Räumen eine unverwechselbare Identität. Dabei machen wir hochwertiges Licht verständlich und erlebbar und schärfen das Bewusstsein für seinen Wert in der Architektur.
Möchtest du unsere Marke mitgestalten und Menschen für gutes Licht begeistern?
Zur Verstärkung unseres Bereichs Forschung und Entwicklung suchenwir dich per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung als:
**Produkt\-Manager/\-in (m/w/d) 80\- 100%**

===================================
Das sind deine Aufgaben
* Du analysierst Markt, Zielgruppen und Wettbewerb und erkennst Trends, Kundenbedürfnisse sowie Marktpotenziale.
* Du definierst und positionierst Produkte innerhalb unseres Portfolios und entwickelst diese konsequent aus Markt\- und Anwendersicht weiter.
* Du erstellst klare Produktanforderungen und definierst Produktnutzen, Funktionen, Varianten sowie Qualitätsanforderungen.
* Du entwickelst Product Briefs und arbeitest eng mit Design, Engineering, Vertrieb sowie weiteren internen und externen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.
* Du begleitest die Produktentwicklung von der Idee über Prototypen und Bemusterungen bis hin zur Markteinführung.
* Du stellst die Wirtschaftlichkeit der Produkte sicher, erstellst Business Cases und bereitest fundierte Go\-/No\-Go\-Entscheidungen vor.
* Du begleitest unsere Produkte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, wertest Marktfeedback aus und leitest daraus Optimierungen, Erweiterungen oder Auslaufentscheidungen ab.
* Du wirkst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktmanagement\- und Produktentstehungsprozesse sowie am Aufbau eines strukturierten Markt\-, Wettbewerbs\- und Kundenwissens mit.
Das bringst du mit
* Technische Ausbildung \- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Elektro\-/Lichttechnik, Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung (FH/HF/Uni). Betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
* Affinität zu Architektur und Design – Du begeisterst dich für Architektur, Design und Licht und bringst ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Gestaltung und hochwertige Produktelösungen mit.
* Erfahrung im Produktmanagement \- Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Produktmanagement mit, idealerweise in der Leuchtenentwicklung, und kennst den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
* Technisches Know\-how \- Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Lichttechnik, Lichtsteuerung und relevanten Normen sowie über Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren Produktfamilien und Variantenmanagement.
* Unternehmerisches Denken \- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Herstellkosten, Kalkulationen, Deckungsbeiträgen und Business Cases. Kenntnisse des Objektgeschäfts und der Vertriebswege im DACH\-Raum sind von Vorteil.
* Arbeitsweise \- Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen. An der Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Design und Engineering trittst Du sicher und überzeugend auf.
* Sprachen – Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C1/C2\) und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch (B1/B2\) – mündlich wie schriftlich.
Das erwartet dich bei uns
Bei RIBAG gestaltest du mit, wie unsere Kunden Licht und unsere Produkte digital entdecken, verstehen und kaufen. Du übernimmst eine vielseitige Schlüsselrolle und entwickelst unsere digitalen Plattformen gemeinsam mit einem motivierten Team und externen Partnern weiter.
Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum, übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst mit deinen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen bewirken. Dazu kommen attraktive Sozialleistungen, fünf Wochen Ferien, abwechslungsreiche Events und Raum für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.
